notes: Apoptotic DNA fragmentation generates pan-nuclear gamma-H2AX that is NOT repair-relevant damage. Without this gate the damage score is confounded by cell death. Non-negotiable channel
gamma-H2AX and RAD51 are strongly S/G2-dependent. All foci counts must be reported cell-cycle-resolved or the score tracks proliferation rather than damage
Separates a high-damage quiescent cell from a high-damage cycling cell; the two have different clinical meaning

clinical_status: extensively validated research biomarker; used in trials as pharmacodynamic endpoint
notes: The best-characterised cellular DNA damage marker. Sensitive but not specific - rises in replication stress and apoptosis as well as true DSB
Co-localisation with gamma-H2AX is what upgrades a gamma-H2AX signal to a bona fide DSB. Requires imaging flow or microscopy for true co-localisation scoring
Autophosphorylation marks ATM activation; distinguishes damage that is being signalled from damage that is being ignored
Downstream of ATM; a high gamma-H2AX with low pCHK2 suggests checkpoint escape - a pro-mutagenic state
Functional HR engagement. Complements the genomic HRD scar score - a tumour can have a high HRD score and still have restored RAD51 loading; that is a PARP-inhibitor resistance phenotype
Direct read of PARP1 catalytic output; the functional counterpart to PARP1 transcript abundance
More DSB-specific than gamma-H2AX because it is not induced by replication stress alone. Used to disambiguate an equivocal gamma-H2AX result
